product.title: 4-hour Drift Fishing in Fort Lauderdale

description.text: Spend four hours offshore with a Fort Lauderdale drift fishing trip designed for mixed experience levels. Fish local reef and coastal waters with crew support, then return to shore with practical guidance on tackle and technique.

highlights: 4-hour drift fishing charter from Fort Lauderdale
Target seasonal reef and pelagic species
Crew assistance for beginners and casual anglers

start.description: Departs from Fort Lauderdale marina area. Exact check-in location and timing appear on your booking confirmation.

itineraryItems.title: Check-in and boarding
itineraryItems.description: Arrive at the marina, check in with crew, and board your fishing vessel.

itineraryItems.title: Offshore drift fishing session
itineraryItems.description: Fish local waters with drift setups while crew provides guidance.

itineraryItems.title: Return to marina
itineraryItems.description: Cruise back to the departure point after the scheduled fishing window.

additionalInfo: Bring weather-appropriate clothing and non-slip footwear
Motion-sickness preparation is recommended for sensitive travelers
Catch limits and seasonal rules follow local regulations

faqs.question: Do I need fishing experience?
faqs.answer: No, this trip is suitable for beginners and experienced anglers.

faqs.question: How long is the charter?
faqs.answer: The trip duration is approximately four hours.

faqs.question: Where do we depart from?
faqs.answer: Departure is from the Fort Lauderdale marina area listed on your confirmation details.
